title: Ai Tech Lead
description:
Preferred Time Zone: CT

Must-Have Skills:

Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality AI agents, skills, assistants, workflows, or integrations. Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows;
skills, tools, and function calling;
Model Context Protocol;
prompt and context design;
retrieval-augmented generation;
enterprise search and data connectors;
grounding, citations, memory, and context management;
model and agent evaluation;
and AI safety and access controls. Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise SaaS, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms. Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management. Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, service accounts, delegated authorization, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.

Notes: No direct reports. This role is more leading through influence by setting standards, mentoring other admins/engineers, etc.

Strong preference in AI technology depth, with lighter platform administration experience rather than the other way around.

Scope of Work: The AI Platform Technical Lead is the hands-on technical owner of the organization's general-purpose, AI-enabled collaboration ecosystem, spanning Slack, Google Workspace with Gemini, Glean, and general-purpose AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT. Working within the strategy and priorities established by the organization, this role translates platform direction into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The Technical Lead configures, maintains, and improves these platforms based on data and feedback;
builds agents and reusable skills;
implements integrations;
establishes technical patterns;
and guides other contributors through technical expertise and example.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain AI agents, skills, prompts, tools, workflows, and automations.
  • Build AI solutions using MCP, function calling, APIs, agents, and integration frameworks.
  • Translate business needs into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready AI capabilities.
  • Build secure integrations across Slack, Google Workspace/Gemini, Glean, AI assistants, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop APIs, data connectors, webhooks, search integrations, and RAG/semantic-search solutions.
  • Ensure AI systems preserve source-system permissions, access controls, data security, and governance requirements.
  • Test and evaluate AI solutions for quality, reliability, safety, performance, and data grounding.
  • Administer and optimize enterprise AI platforms, including access, configurations, integrations, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot complex AI platform, integration, connector, and data-retrieval issues.
  • Establish standards for AI agents, integrations, configurations, testing, deployment, and security.
  • Lead technical solution reviews, mentor contributors, and serve as the senior technical escalation point.
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide technical recommendations to platform leadership.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we've put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We're a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance.

You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office.

As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years' relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Supervisor Fiscal

  • Aplicar os seusconceitos de manutenção com foco na otimização dos equipamentos, dos processos e dos orçamentos, de modo a alcançar uma melhor mantenabilidade, confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos equipamentos;

  • Elaborar as especificações técnicas dos equipamentos e sistemas a serem implantados, apresentando relatório técnico de análises comparativas e conclusivas;
  • Deliberar e decidir o processo de compra de equipamentos e serviços técnicos, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e dar suporte técnico para a deliberação sobre o processo da aquisição, controlando a fase de fornecimento visando assegurar a qualidade e cronograma acordado;
  • Controlar o projeto, desenvolvimento e a implantação dos equipamentos, instalações, layout ou estruturas, realizando testes a vazio, comissionamento e operação assistida, assegurando o repasse à equipe de operação das plantas industriais, visando a disponibilidade operacional e o perfeito funcionamento para atender às demandas das áreas;
  • Elaborar análises de viabilidade orçamentária e técnica dos projetos, de acordo com os metodologias e procedimentos internos, visando atender às demandas de melhorias de processos, qualidade e custos;
  • Dar suporte na identificação, desenvolvimento e qualificação de fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, de acordo com os procedimentos internos, visando o atendimento às demandas da área;
  • Buscar a inovação e o aprimoramento dos processos produtivos, através da identificação, estudo de soluções, seleção e implantação de novas tecnologias e materiais, visando estar em conformidade com as melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Gerenciar a documentação técnica, administrativa dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade, de acordo com os procedimentos internos, visando garantir o cumprimento das fases físico-financeiras do projeto;
  • Responder como responsável técnico, quando necessário, pelos projetos e ações relacionados à sua área de atuação e condução, visando o atendimento às demandas da área;
  • Responder como responsável técnico, quando necessário, pelas Normas Regulamentadoras relacionados à sua área de atuação e condução, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando obter a máxima eficiência no processo de produção;

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica;

Registro no Conselho de Classe ativo;

Pacote Office;

Experiência em atividades correlatas à descrição da posição;

Disponibilidade para residir em Riacho dos Machados/MG ou região.

title: Analista De Operações De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O IBF (Instituto Brasileiro de Florestas) atua no setor florestal de madeiras nobres desde 2006, com sede em Londrina/PR e operação de campo em MG. Em quase duas décadas de atuação, tornou-se referência nacional em silvicultura de madeira nobre, com milhares de hectares sob gestão e centenas de clientes.

Estamos construindo uma cultura AI-first em nossos departamentos e buscamos pessoas que queiram aprender, assumir responsabilidades, melhorar processos e crescer junto com a empresa.

Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Operações Comerciais para apoiar e organizar a operação dos SDRs e consultores de negócios, garantindo que processos, informações, materiais e atividades comerciais sigam os fluxos definidos pela diretoria.

Essa pessoa será responsável pela operação e governança do CRM, pelo acompanhamento dos indicadores da jornada comercial e pelo suporte de bastidor à equipe. Também participará da criação e melhoria de scripts, propostas, relatórios, automações, treinamentos e procedimentos.

A posição é ligada diretamente à diretoria e terá espaço para identificar problemas, analisar gargalos e propor melhorias nos processos comerciais e na jornada do cliente.

Não se trata de uma função de atendimento ou negociação direta com leads e clientes. O foco estará na organização, análise e melhoria da operação, apoiando três consultores de negócios e dois SDRs.

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar e manter organizado todo o fluxo comercial no CRM;
  • Distribuir leads entre SDRs e consultores de negócios conforme os critérios definidos pela diretoria;
  • Conferir o preenchimento das informações e garantir a qualidade dos dados registrados no CRM;
  • Acompanhar a movimentação dos leads e oportunidades entre as etapas do funil;
  • Identificar leads parados, atividades vencidas, oportunidades sem acompanhamento e falhas no processo;
  • Cobrar e acompanhar a atualização das informações pelos responsáveis;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento dos procedimentos, prazos e rotinas comerciais;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de toda a jornada comercial, desde a entrada do lead pelo marketing até o fechamento ou perda da oportunidade;
  • Elaborar relatórios e painéis para acompanhamento da diretoria;
  • Monitorar volume de leads, tentativas de contato, chamadas, reuniões agendadas e realizadas, propostas enviadas, conversões por etapa, motivos de perda e produtividade da equipe;
  • Apoiar a elaboração da previsão de vendas e o acompanhamento do pipeline comercial;
  • Organizar e conferir as informações utilizadas no cálculo das comissões;
  • Criar, revisar e manter atualizados scripts de prospecção, atendimento, qualificação e acompanhamento;
  • Criar, preencher, adaptar e melhorar modelos de propostas comerciais;
  • Redigir novos materiais e versões de scripts e propostas para validação da diretoria;

title: Head Of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
We are looking for a customer-focused Technical Sales Engineer to join Quortex.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.

This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.

Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.

What you'll do

Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting

  • Act as a technical advisor and subject matter expert for customers and partners.
  • Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches.
  • Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers.
  • Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.

Solution Design and Technical Leadership

  • Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including SaaS, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings.
  • Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives.
  • Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows.
  • Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring.
  • Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps.
  • Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.

Pre-Sales Support

  • Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria.
  • Participate in RFP and RFI processes.
  • Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements.
  • Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.

Business Development and Market Engagement

  • Contribute to territory planning and account strategies.
  • Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content.
  • Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities.
  • Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required.
  • Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams.
  • Provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to support product development.
  • Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.

What we're looking for

Mandatory Technical Experience

  • Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:

Ingest

Encoding and transcoding

Statistical multiplexing, or statmux

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR

Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT

Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH

Primary distribution

Cable distribution

  • Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations.
  • Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows.
  • Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions.
  • Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria.
  • Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations.
  • Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals.
  • Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies.
  • Experience with live and on-demand video architectures.
  • Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable Technical Experience

  • Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models.
  • Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI.
  • Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI.
  • Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud.
  • Knowledge of broadcast and media standards, including:

SMPTE ST 2110

SCTE-35

SCTE-224

  • Experience with Content Delivery Networks.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
  • Experience with video compression, packaging, encoding, DRM, and content delivery.
  • Understanding of cloud-based media workflows and recording solutions.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.

Business and Customer Skills

  • Ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience discussing both technical requirements and business outcomes with customers.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of SaaS business models.
  • A customer-focused approach supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience working with partners, resellers, systems integrators, or other ecosystem stakeholders is advantageous.

Differentiators

The following experience is not required but would be considered an advantage:

  • Participation in large-scale projects as a Solutions Architect or in a similar technical leadership role.
  • Programming or scripting skills.
  • Experience representing an organization at trade shows as an exhibitor, speaker, or technical presenter.
  • Cloud architecture certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or another recognized provider.
  • Additional training or certifications in video technologies, broadcast engineering, networking, or cloud architecture.

Preferred Background

We welcome candidates from a range of sectors, including:

  • Media and Entertainment
  • Streaming Platforms
  • Telecommunications
  • Cloud and SaaS Companies
  • Video Technology Vendors
  • Systems Integration and Consulting

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager

Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C (exclusive membership services), B2B (corporate travel management), and B2B2C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool.

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.

CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)

We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.
  • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.
  • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.
  • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.
  • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

  • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

- Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus

Why Join Us

  • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.
  • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.
  • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.
  • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements

bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company's evolution and stakes.

Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws).
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.

Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.

Important Note Before Applying:

Let's keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume. We're not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one.

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms;
we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we're excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let's keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

bTd Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Consultor De Demanda - Neurologia
description:
Descrição do Cargo: Como Consultor de Demanda especializado em Neurologia, você desempenhará um papel estratégico na identificação e no engajamento dos HCPs-alvo e na gestão do território sob sua responsabilidade.

Sua atuação será fundamental para apoiar o propósito da Multicare de melhorar e prolongar a vida dos pacientes, por meio da construção de relacionamentos de confiança, geração de valor para os profissionais de saúde e excelência na execução da estratégia do produto.

O objetivo é impulsionar a geração de demanda de maneira ética, sustentável e orientada às necessidades dos pacientes e dos profissionais de saúde.

Qualificações

Formação: Superior em Administração de Empresas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou áreas correlatas.

Basico: Conhecimento sólido do sistema de saúde brasileiro, tanto público quanto privado, e do mercado farmacêutico.

Específicos: Compreensão das particularidades e desafios relacionados às doenças raras e/ou à neurologia, bem como capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Operações e demais áreas envolvidas, contribuindo para o sucesso da estratégia do produto e, principalmente, para a jornada do paciente;

Experiência: Experiência prévia no setor farmacêutico, preferencialmente em posições relacionadas à geração de demanda, promoção de produtos farmacêuticos e relacionamento com neurologistas, neurologistas pediátricos e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos na jornada do paciente.

É desejável experiência comprovada em:

  • geração de demanda;
  • planejamento eexecução de visitas;
  • gestão de território e contas;
  • relacionamentoe engajamento com HCPs;
  • acesso ao mercado de saúde brasileiro;
  • atuação nos sistemas público e privado de saúde;
  • produtos de alta complexidade, neurologia e/ou doenças raras.

Atribuições e Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, personalizar e executar jornadas de engajamento para HCPs-alvo, considerando suas necessidades e preferências e utilizando adequadamente os conteúdos e canais de interação disponibilizados pela companhia.
  • Construir relacionamentos profissionais sólidos e sustentáveis com HCPs e demais stakeholders estratégicos, buscando estabelecer uma colaboração de longo prazo e gerar valor para os clientes, pacientes e para a Multicare.
  • Proporcionar uma experiência de excelência e centrada no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades, seu ambiente de saúde e os desafios relacionados à jornada do paciente.
  • Utilizar de forma estratégica as fontes de dados e informações disponíveis para segmentar, priorizar e revisar continuamente o território, as contas e os planos de interação com clientes.
  • Desenvolver e executar planos de território e de contas, estabelecendo prioridades, objetivos, indicadores e ações necessárias para maximizar o potencial de cada região sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades e barreiras relacionadas ao diagnóstico, tratamento, acesso e jornada do paciente, compartilhando os insights relevantes com as áreas internas responsáveis.
  • Compartilhar continuamente percepções e insights dos clientes com os stakeholders internos pertinentes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de conteúdos, campanhas, estratégias e planos de interação relacionados ao produto e à sua indicação.
  • Trabalhar de maneira integrada com equipes multifuncionais, especialmente Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Marketing e Operações, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções que atendam às necessidades identificadas no mercado.
  • Desenvolver e manter conhecimento aprofundado sobre o produto, sua indicação, o cenário terapêutico, a jornada do paciente, o ambiente competitivo e as particularidades do território sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Contribuir para a geração de demanda de forma responsável, sustentável e ética, respeitando rigorosamente as indicações aprovadas, as políticas internas da Multicare e todas as normas regulatórias e de compliance aplicáveis.
  • Monitorar sistematicamente os resultados e indicadores de performance de seu território, identificando desvios, oportunidades e ações necessárias para o atingimento dos objetivos estabelecidos.
  • Representar a Multicare perante médicos, instituições e demais stakeholders de maneira profissional, ética e compatível com os valores e padrões de excelência da companhia.
  • Agir permanentemente com integridade, transparência e respeito no relacionamento com clientes, pacientes, colegas e parceiros.

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Buscamos profissionais ambiciosos, comprometidos e orientados a resultados, que desejem integrar um time de alta performance, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e estratégico.

Procuramos pessoas com forte capacidade de execução, maturidade profissional, senso de responsabilidade e disposição para assumir protagonismo na gestão de seu território.

Em um modelo de gestão de contas e territórios, o Consultor será responsável por liderar sua região com visão estratégica, disciplina de execução e foco em resultados, promovendo um elevado nível de engajamento com médicos e demais stakeholders.

Esperamos uma atuação pautada por excelência, ética, compliance, colaboração multidisciplinar e foco permanente no paciente, contribuindo para ampliar o acesso a terapias inovadoras em neurologia e para consolidar a Multicare como um parceiro de confiança dos profissionais e instituições de saúde.

title: Especialista De Pcp
description:
A Frimesa é hoje uma das maiores e mais importantes empresas de alimentos do Brasil, consolidada como uma Cooperativa Central. Com mais de 45 anos de história, a Frimesa se destaca em dois pilares principais:

Carne Suína: É a 4a maior empresa do segmento no Brasil. Possuindo o maior frigorífico de suínos da América Latina, utilizando tecnologia de ponta e automação de nível mundial.

Laticínios: Possui uma das marcas mais lembradas pelos consumidores brasileiros, com um portfólio completo que vai de queijos a iogurtes e sobremesas.

cada Linha de Produção

de produção

de resultados

  • Graduação completa em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária, Agronomia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência consolidada em nutrição animal voltada para aves.

Ou

title: Analista De Crédito Pleno
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!

O que você precisa ter para fazer acontecer:

Requisitos obrigatórios:

Experiência em Crédito e Cobrança ou Contas a Receber;

Vivência com análise de crédito B2B;

Conhecimento em análise de Balanço Patrimonial e DRE;

Experiência com processos de cobrança e negociação de débitos;

Conhecimento em sistemas ERP, preferencialmente SAP;

Excel intermediário;

Familiaridade comconsultas em bureaus de crédito e ferramentas de análise de risco.

Local de trabalho: Santo Amaro | São Paulo / SP.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, sendo 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia em home office por semana.

Oferecemos:

  • Refeitório na empresa;
  • Vale transporteou estacionamento;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados (PLR);
  • Wellhub para seu bem-estar físico e mental.

Na Apsen, incentivamos a participação de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTI+, e pessoas com deficiência. Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

title: Analista Financeiro
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A IDV é especializada no desenvolvimento e fornecimento de soluções veiculares e de proteção para o setor de defesa. No Brasil, estamos presentes desde 2011, com nossa planta industrial operando desde 2013 e globalmente, atuamos desde 1937. A empresa tem protagonizado a transformação do setor de defesa, moldando o presente e o futuro com inovação, identidade e resultados concretos. Presente em 8 países, a IDV reafirma seu compromisso com a excelência e com a evolução contínua das soluções voltadas para a defesa.

  • Desenvolver simulações e cenários financeiros para suportar tomadas de decisão estratégicas;
  • Consolidar e analisar custos diretos e indiretos, avaliando impactos na formação de preços;
  • Criar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho relacionados à precificação e rentabilidade;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e análises para suporte às áreas de negócio;
  • Atuar em interface com Controladoria, Comercial e demais áreas para validação de políticas de preços, orçamento e forecast.

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Experiência em precificação, análise financeira, controladoria ou áreas relacionadas;

Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.

title: Fincrime Analyst (Investigations) - Brazil
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut's efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We're looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we're treating customers fairly. You'll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.

To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes

What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.G., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends

Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.G., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.

We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Senior Creative Strategist Latam
description:
Genero is looking for a Senior Creative Strategist LATAM to lead creative strategy across our platform partnerships and enterprise accounts.

This role combines creative strategy with strong production fluency. You'll set the creative direction for your projects, then own how it gets made: selecting and briefing creators and production companies, reviewing treatments and creative output, and consulting closely with the client services team throughout the process. You'll work across platform partners including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Google and on enterprise accounts including Bayer, P&G, Canva and Pernod.

Responsibilities

Creative strategy and Leadership

Set the standard for creative briefing, storytelling and creator selection across every project

Own Creative strategy across projects and platform programmes, translating platform-specific opportunities into sharp, on-brand creative direction

Stay ahead of trends, formats and creators across Meta, Pinterest, TikTok and Google, keeping concepts current and platform-native.

Translate client goals and audience insight into creative strategy, working directly with senior client teams.

Lead client presentations and workshops, together with Client Services, pitching creative strategies and direction that align with business and marketing objectives.

Bring creative strategy input to pitches and new business proposals, alongside the senior leadership team.

Creative partner and production management: source, brief and manage the creative partners behind the work, including production companies delivering multi-shoot or multi-market campaigns. Review treatments and bids, creatively manage partners, and hold delivery to a quality bar without micromanaging craft.

Creator curation: identify, vet and manage the creators and talent attached to Paid Partnership briefs and high-profile projects, justifying every recommendation on strategic and platform fit.

Platform and trend fluency: maintain a working, current understanding of format and platform shifts across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Google, and translate that into briefs, not just reporting.

Requirements

  • 7-10 years in creative strategy, content strategy or social/paid partnerships, client-side, platform-side or agency
  • Direct experience managing production companies or production partners end to end: treatments, budgets, timelines, delivery
  • Fluency in social platforms (Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, Google); including understandingof trends and best practices
  • A proven track record managing creator or talent relationships directly
  • Comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders and leading pitches or workshops

Mandatory

  • Must be Fluent in English and Spanish
  • Based in São Paulo
  • Hybrid work model

title: Analytics And Automation Specialist
description:
REMOTE ANALYTICS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST TO WORK WITH SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA AGENCY.

About The Role

SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.

The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.

Working Hours & Availability

This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential:

  • Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day
  • The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone

Key Responsibilities

1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround

2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed

3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.G. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops

4. AI Automation (new capability)

Design and build AI-powered automation flows to streamline reporting, data extraction, and routine admin tasks (e.G. using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom scripts)

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows currently done manually across admin and implementation tasks

Build and maintain automations that pull from analytics platforms (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio) and push into reporting or notification systems

Document automation logic clearly so workflows are maintainable by others on the team

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup
  • Experience with event tracking implementation and debugging data discrepancies
  • Comfort pulling data from third-party platforms via APIs, and general familiarity working with API endpoints
  • Understanding of measurement frameworks and attribution modelling
  • Working knowledge of privacy/compliance requirements affecting tracking (e.G. cookie consent)
  • Demonstrated experience building AI automation flows — e.G. Zapier, Make.Com, n8n, or custom integrations using LLM/API-based tooling
  • Strong documentation habits
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while flagging proactive recommendations
  • Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential
  • Comfortable communicating directly with clients, including handling complex briefs and translating technical detail into clear, client-ready language

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance
  • Prior agency-side experience managing enterprise client relationships
  • Exposure to Python or JavaScript for custom automation/scripting

Working Arrangements

  • Must be available Sydney 9:00am–1:00pm (AEST/AEDT) daily for overlap with the Sydney team; remaining hours of the 8-hour day are flexible.
  • Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines.
  • Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above.
  • Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish
  • Competitive salary in USD.

  • Identificar discrepâncias entre os registros de estoque e a contagem física, relatar essas discrepâncias aos supervisores e auxiliar na investigação das causas.
  • Após a contagem, reembalar ou reorganizar os produtos de acordo com as diretrizes da empresa, garantindo que tudo esteja em ordem.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com a equipe de supervisão e outros departamentos, informando sobre o progresso da contagem de inventário e quaisquer problemas encontrados.
  • Preparar relatórios de inventário, se necessário, fornecendo informações sobre os resultados da contagem e quaisquer discrepâncias identificadas.
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas relacionados ao estoque e na implementação de melhorias nos processos de inventário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens

Informações adicionais

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Bônus anual;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;
  • Wellhub (plataforma de bem-estar que oferece opções de atividades físicas, mindfulness e outros);
  • Educa Mais (planos personalizados de graduação, pós-graduação, mentorias, cursos livres e de idiomas);
  • Desconto em aluguéis de carro;
  • Desconto em passagens áreas;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil, que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

title: Pessoa Estagiária De Engenharia - Indicadores
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Coordenação do time de Marketing e elaboração do planejamento estratégico anual;

  • Gerenciamento do planejamento, junto da agência de mídia nacional e assessoria de imprensa;
  • Desenvolvimentode projetos especiais focados em implementação de novas frentes de trabalho, prospecção de eventos, captação de patrocínio;
  • Acompanhamento,mapeamento e implementação de melhorias dentro da vertical de mídia no shopping;
  • Gerenciamento da performance de mídia paga e CRM, Programas de benefícios do shopping, envolvendo definição da objetivos, estratégia, implementação, acompanhamento, relatório de resultados e KPIs estratégicos.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support iQIYI's expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Estágiário(A) Sales - International Trading Desk
description:

Fundada em 1997 na Coreia do Sul e presente em 19 países, a Mirae Asset é um conglomerado financeiro global que oferece soluções de investimento inovadoras para clientes ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, atuamos como corretora de valores, conectando o mercado local a nossa presença internacional e colocando à disposição de investidores pessoas físicas e institucionais produtos e serviços de primeira linha. Nosso compromisso é unir solidez global, inovação e proximidade no atendimento para apoiar nossos clientes em seus objetivos de investimento.

#VemSerMiraeAsset

Estágio de Sales - Câmbio

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Auxiliar na apresentação de soluções personalizadas, alinhadas às necessidades e ao perfil de cada cliente;
  • Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para expansão da base de clientes;
  • Dar suporte às atividades da mesa de câmbio, contribuindo para o alcance dos resultados da área.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior em andamento em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas (conclusão prevista a partir de 2028);
  • Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita;
  • Perfil proativo, dinâmico e orientado para resultados;
  • Interesse pela área comercial e mercado financeiro.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento emExcel;
  • Interesse ou conhecimento no mercado de câmbio e produtos financeiros;
  • Experiência prévia em atividades comerciais ou atendimento ao cliente.

O que nós oferecemos:

Na Mirae Asset Brasil valorizamos a saúde e o bem-estar, oferecendo um extenso portfólio de benefícios a todas as nossas pessoas colaboradoras:

  • Vale Refeição - Cartão CAJU (Sem desconto);

title: Assistente Comercial
description:
Se você busca trabalhar em um ambiente inovador, dinâmico, e inspirador, a HD Distribuidora é o lugar certo para você!

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuarem no nosso setor comercial interno com foco em atendimento ao cliente.

Como uma das principais empresas do mercado de distribuição no Brasil, oferecemos a oportunidade de transformar sua carreira e crescer profissionalmente junto a um time motivado e apaixonado pelo que faz.

Por que trabalhar na HD Distribuidora?

  • Liderança de Mercado: Atendemos clientes em todo o Brasil, sendo referência em qualidade e excelência no segmento de distribuição em higiene profissional.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Investimos no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores, com treinamentos e oportunidades reais de evolução na carreira.
  • Inovação e Tecnologia: Trabalhe em uma empresa que utiliza as melhores ferramentas e práticas do mercado para entregar resultados de impacto.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Valorizamos a diversidade, o respeito e a troca de ideias. Aqui o trabalho em equipe faz a diferença!
  • Propósito e Impacto: Na HD, você participa de projetos que realmente transformam vidas e negócios.

O que buscamos?

Procuramos pessoas apaixonadas por desafios, com espírito de equipe, foco na excelência e que estejam prontas para fazer a diferença! Valorizamos também a vontade de aprender e crescer, independentemente da área.

Junte-se a nós!

Faça parte de uma empresa que não para de crescer e transforma oportunidades em grandes realizações. Se você se identifica com os nossos valores e gosta de trabalhar com pessoas que fazem a diferença todos os dias, queremos você no nosso time!

Vaga para a Unidade de Ijuí

Venha escrever sua história com a gente e crescer conosco. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e atividades

Atividades:

Atendimento ao cliente na sua real necessidade, esse é o objetivo do nosso setor comercial interno. Você irá realizar o atendimento à carteira de clientes já existente, agregando novidades, promoções e novos itens através de contato telefônico e WhatsApp. Você também deverá estudar de forma sistemática as soluções da HD para que possa sempre levar aos clientes a solução correta para as suas necessidades;
irá estruturar e enviarrelatórios, preparar e enviar propostas comerciais, cadastrar e manter os cadastros dos clientes sempre atualizados, auxiliar nas vendas dos vendedores externos e dos representantes comerciais e incluir, alterar e excluir pedidos no sistema.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio;
  • Experiência de três anos no setor comercial;
  • Conhecimento Pacote Office;
  • Boa capacidadede comunição e proatividade;
  • Análise e interpretação de relatórios;
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas de informática.

Informações Adicionais:

Horários de trabalho, de segunda à sexta, das 08:00hs às 12:00hs e das 13:30hs às 18:00hs.

Remuneração compatível com a função + ótimos benefícios.

Cidade de atuação: Ijuí / RS

Benefícios:

  • Bonificação em produtos
  • Comissões
  • Descontos em Produtos
  • Treinamentos
  • Uniforme
  • Gratificação

title: Analista Jurídico | Contencioso Cível
